result.topic_en: Euler determines the coefficients α, β, γ, δ for a further case of the vibrating elastic lamina, reduces it to the transcendental equation tan ω = (e^ω − e^{−ω})/(e^ω + e^{−ω}) already met in the second case, and states the resulting curve, the oscillation time and the emitted sound.
result.transcription:
Ex priore fit
$\frac{\alpha}{\gamma}=\frac{-\sin.\omega}{e^{\omega}-e^{-\omega}}$, ex altera vero $\frac{\alpha}{\gamma}=\frac{-\cos.\omega}{e^{\omega}+e^{-\omega}}$;
ex quibus porro colligitur $\tang.\omega=\frac{e^{\omega}-e^{-\omega}}{e^{\omega}+e^{-\omega}}$, quae formula plane conuenit cum ea, quam casu secundo inuenimus, eritque idcirco, vt ibi, vel
$\sin.\omega=\frac{e^{\omega}-e^{-\omega}}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$ et $\cos.\omega=\frac{e^{\omega}+e^{-\omega}}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$, vel
$\sin.\omega=\frac{-e^{\omega}+e^{-\omega}}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$ et $\cos.\omega=\frac{-e^{\omega}-e^{-\omega}}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$.
Ex prioribus valoribus elicitur $\frac{\alpha}{\gamma}=\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$, ex alteris autem valoribus fit $\frac{\alpha}{\gamma}=\frac{+1}{\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}}$; vnde his binis casibus coniungendis habebimus $\alpha=1$, $\beta=-1$, $\gamma=\mp\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}$ et $\delta=0$; vbi vt hactenus signorum ambiguorum superius valet, si anguli $\omega$ tam sinus quam cosinus fuerint positiui, inferius autem si ambo fuerint negatiui, vnde pro quouis valore $\omega$ habebitur
$y=C\sin.(\zeta+t\sqrt{\tfrac{2g}{k}})(e^{u\omega}-e^{-u\omega}\mp\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}\sin.u\omega)$;
praeterea vero vt hactenus erit $\frac{\sqrt{2g}}{k}=\frac{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}$, tempus vnius oscillationis $=\frac{\pi aa}{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}$ et sonus editus $=\frac{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}{\pi aa}$.
Corollarium 1.
§. 40. Quia aequatio resoluenda: $\tang.\omega=\frac{e^{\omega}-e^{-\omega}}{e^{\omega}+e^{-\omega}}$ prorsus conuenit cum ea, quam casu secundo iam resoluimus
